problem_statement: Blue Technology Studio (蓝色技术工作室) is a student technology-club promotional site built on this Vue 2 single-page app (a Vue CLI + element-ui build with a persistent top nav and four routed pages behind a hash router: the home page 首页, the software team page 软件部, the hardware team page 硬件部 and the promotion page 推广, all sharing a dark-blue starry theme with the studio's signature blue #3c70ea accent). The club wants a small, consistent '工作室速览' (Studio pulse) rail to sit in the footer of every page: a labelled row of five at-a-glance metric chips (在研项目 active projects, 招新席位 recruiting seats, 开放课题 open topics, 展示作品 showcase works, 竞赛捷报 contest wins) plus a live '速览视角' (pulse view) readout with a '切换速览视角' toggle that tells a visitor whether the rail is currently showing 本周动态 (this week's activity) or 本学期成果 (this term's results) — the numbers read differently under each view, so the rail should always name the view it is set to. Ship the Studio pulse rail so it (1) appears in the footer on the home, software, hardware and promotion pages alike, (2) lays out its chip row responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone, (3) matches the site's blue starry styling (a blue dashed-accent chip idiom, not an off-brand dark-teal slab), and (4) keeps the '速览视角' readout in sync with the toggle so a visitor who switches to the term view sees the readout update to 本学期成果. Keep the rest of the site — the top nav, the four routed pages, the language and theme pickers, the static build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared '工作室速览' (Studio pulse) rail to the site footer so it renders on the home, software (软件部), hardware (硬件部) and promotion (推广) pages (a shared component invoked from the app shell footer, not a per-page copy).

The rail shows a '工作室速览' title, a chip row of the five metric chips (在研项目 active projects, 招新席位 recruiting seats, 开放课题 open topics, 展示作品 showcase works, 竞赛捷报 contest wins), and a '速览视角' readout with a '切换速览视角' toggle.
The chip row must wrap responsively so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).
Style the rail in the site's blue starry language (a blue #3c70ea dashed-accent chip idiom), consistent and legible, not an off-brand dark-teal slab.

Wire the '速览视角' readout to the pulse-view toggle: after clicking the toggle, the readout must read 本学期成果 when the rail is set to the term view — it must re-read the live pulse mode, not show a stale captured value.
Preserve the top nav, the four routed pages, the language and theme pickers and the static build with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the pjqdyd Vue-bst-web Vue 2 promotional site (a Vue CLI + element-ui + vue-router + vue-i18n single-page app for 蓝色技术工作室 / Blue Technology Studio, dark-blue starry theme with the studio's signature blue #3c70ea accent used across the nav and section headings). The shared Studio pulse rail is rendered from the app-shell footer component and reuses the site's own blue accent and its local iconfont and image assets; the remote CDN scripts and the unpkg element-ui stylesheet are replaced with locally bundled dependencies so no remote assets are fetched. The responsive chip-row layout and the toggle readout wiring were designed by hand for this Blue Technology Studio brand, not bulk-generated.
design_constraints: Implement the Studio pulse rail as a shared component rendered from the app-shell footer so a single source of truth reaches every page; do not paste divergent copies per page or build a detached widget.
The chip row must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile; the chip spacing must stay legible.

The rail must adopt the site's blue starry palette, dashed-accent chip style and typography so it reads as part of Blue Technology Studio, not a foreign block; keep it consistent with the site's own image and icon assets.
The '速览视角' readout must reflect the CURRENT pulse mode after every toggle by reading the live data-pulse-mode, so it can never go stale relative to the visible palette.
Do not remove or regress the top nav, the four routed pages, the language and theme pickers or the static build.

change_completion: The Studio pulse rail is present in the footer of the home, software and hardware pages (the shared component reaches all pages, not just the home page).
After clicking the pulse-view toggle on the home page, the '速览视角' readout updates to 本学期成果 — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 本周动态.
design_consistency: The rail on the footer states matches the reference's blue dashed-accent styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an off-brand dark-teal slab.
The rail adopts the site's blue #3c70ea dashed-accent idiom so it reads as part of Blue Technology Studio across the pages.
responsive: No captured page overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the chip row wraps.
desktop_rail_home, mobile_rail_home and mobile_initial keep the Studio pulse rail readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The top nav and the four routed pages remain present and navigable.
The language and theme pickers and the static build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the home hero and the responsive shell.
desktop_software, mobile_software and desktop_hardware protect the routed pages and carry the Studio pulse rail in the footer.
mobile_promote protects the promotion page's mobile layout without overflow.
desktop_rail_home and mobile_rail_home scroll the Studio pulse rail into view and must show the blue dashed-accent rail without horizontal overflow.
desktop_rail_software, desktop_rail_hardware and desktop_rail_promote protect the rail's presence on the software, hardware and promotion footers.
toggle_pulse_home clicks the pulse-view toggle; the '速览视角' readout must then read 本学期成果.
